DROP VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_DEP_CASA]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_DEP_CASA] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
		MAX(FullDate) FullDate
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= DEPOSITS_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' 
    AND MONTH_END='Y'
    ) A
)
SELECT
RW.FullDate AS asofDate,
EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY AS cifNumber,
EDF.ACCT_NAME AS accountName,
EDF.SOL_ID AS solidBranch,
EBD.SOL_DESC AS branch,
EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS schmType,
EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE AS schmCode,
EDG.SCHM_DESC productDescription,
EDF.FORACID_UNMASKED AS accountNumber,
EDF.TRAN_DATE_BAL currentBalance,
EDF.VALUE_DATE_BAL availableBalance,
CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 rmAssigned,
EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE currency,
RW.FullDate transDateValueDate
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
		ON RW.FullDate = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.del_flg='N'
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA','SBA')
    LEFT JOIN eds.Customer_Dim AS CRM_ACCOUNTS
        ON CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = EDF.CUST_ID
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31'
	LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
		ON EDF.SOL_ID = EBD.SOL_ID
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EBD.BANK_ID
		AND EBD.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31'
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE EDG
		ON EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE=EDG.SCHM_CODE
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDG.BANK_ID
		AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN EDG.SCD_START_DATE AND EDG.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE	
	CRM_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
	AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 IS NOT NULL;
GO
